size.value: Minimum 400 (width) x 600 (height) pixels, with the face occupying approximately 70-80% of the photo

file_spec.value: JPEG format. Maximum file size was cited as 1024KB in the most recent confirmation of this official page; an earlier citation of the same page stated a 500KB maximum (10KB minimum). The exact current KB ceiling could not be pinned down with full confidence across research passes -- treat as approximate (500KB-1024KB range).

validity.value: Photo must be taken within the last 6 months

expression_restriction.value: Neutral facial expression, both eyes open, full-face view directly facing the camera

clothing_restriction.value: Clothing normally worn on a daily basis

expression.en: Neutral facial expression with both eyes open, in full-face view directly facing the camera.
expression.ko: 양쪽 눈을 뜨고 정면을 응시하는 중립적인 표정이어야 한다.
expression.ja: 両目を開け、カメラに正対した中立的な表情であること。

clothing.en: Wear clothing normally worn on a daily basis; avoid uniforms or costumes.
clothing.ko: 평상시 일상적으로 착용하는 복장을 입어야 하며, 제복이나 특수 복장은 피해야 한다.
clothing.ja: 普段着用している日常の服装を着用すること。制服やコスチュームは避けること。

db_conflicts.research_value: Minimum 400x600px digital upload (aspect ratio ~2:3), per Iran's official e-visa portal -- a different aspect ratio than DB's 3:4 cm figure, and measured in pixels (digital minimum) rather than a fixed cm print size

cross_verification.note_en: Source is Iran's official e-visa portal (evisatraveller.mfa.ir, under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs mfa.ir domain), which appeared directly in search results across multiple independent queries with consistent figures (400x600px min, white/off-white background, 70-80% face fill, 6-month currency, neutral expression). Direct WebFetch access repeatedly failed (redirect loop), so confirmation relies on search-engine indexing of the specific official URL rather than a raw page fetch. Headwear/hijab requirements were investigated but found genuinely inconsistent even in secondary reporting (some sources say hijab is optional for the digital e-visa photo specifically, others say mandatory as for all Iranian document photos) -- left unverified rather than resolved by guessing. This ir-visa record covers the MFA e-visa (evisatraveller.mfa.ir); Iran's separate domestic passport photo requirements (via NAJA/epolice.ir) are recorded independently under ir-passport.json and could not be verified from an official domain.
